newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on blue-chip buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on blue-chip buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Friday on fresh blue-chip buying before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 16.15 points, or 1.06 percent, up at 1,537.52 amid 128 losers and 94 gainers in a turnover of 26 million shares, against Thursday's 46 million.
PTCL rose 0.80 rupees to 26.40, HUBCO 0.65 to 37.75, ICI 0.40 to 23.40, PSO 6.0 to 292 and Sui Northern 1.50 to 29.25. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
